messages:
Ava (Product): quick sync — we need to lock scope for this sprint: dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks, and the lightweight error analytics surface. customers keep pushing for per-route cost breakdowns. can we agree on a minimum launch surface?
Jon (Eng): my concern is tracing hooks — full-span capture + per-token metadata will blow storage and latency. we should scope to sampling + tag carryover first.
Priya (SRE): +1. propose default sampling at 10% and higher for paid accounts; keep an agent-side filter to avoid PII.
Liam (Data): for per-route cost breakdown we can do token-attribution aggregated by route if we get per-request model & token counts. storage delta should be modest if we only keep 90 days aggregated buckets.
Marta (CS): customers asking for per-team cost alerts and quick downloadable CSVs. if we cut features, prioritize alerts + CSV over custom visualizations.
Ravi (Design): can we ship a compact dashboard tile that shows top 5 routes by cost and top 5 errors? low-fidelity first, then expand. I sketched a 3-column layout. link: https://figma.com/s/jt-obs-tile
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded: https://docs.internal/release/obs-minisurface (artifact 499123) :white_check_mark:
Ava (Product): sounds like consensus: MVP = 1) cost tile (top routes, CSV export), 2) tracing hooks with sampling + tag carryover, 3) basic error analytics (grouping + frequency). open questions: sampling default, retention, and launch acceptance criteria.
Jon (Eng): technical acceptance: tracing hook latency must not add >5ms p50 to requests; sampling configurable per-customer; fallback route if agent fails.
Priya (SRE): ops acceptance: storage delta estimate <12% of logs bill for default sampling. we need alerting on malformed spans and PII detection hits.
Liam (Data): data acceptance: aggregated per-route cost tables match billing within 1.5% on sample customers. CSV generated in <30s for 30 days.
Marta (CS): customer acceptance: 3 enterprise customers sign off on CSV + alerts as sufficient for initial rollout. otherwise we delay.
Ravi (Design): UX acceptance: tile works at 320px min width, accessible colors, and copy approved by legal for redaction hints.
Jon (Eng): implementation note: we'll expose sampling via API + console toggle. sample config example:```yaml
tracing:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.10
  pii_filter: true
```
Priya (SRE): also add agent config for cold-start safe mode: if collector unreachable, fall back to local aggregation and drop verbose payloads.
Ava (Product): timeline: sprint 2 (2 weeks) feature flag behind alpha, sprint 3 roll to beta for selected customers, GA after 2 weeks of beta with signoffs.
Marta (CS): I'll line up customer signoffs: AcmeHealth + ShopEZ + EduLabs for beta.
Jon (Eng): blockers: need exact storage estimate and perf test harness. I'll mock load and share numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Liam (Data): I'll prepare cost aggregation SQL and a small ETL to generate CSVs. ETA 48h.
Priya (SRE): I'll add alert rules and a playbook for PII detections.
Ava (Product): OK — action items: @Jon run perf + storage estimate, @Liam build aggregation, @Marta coordinate signoffs, @Ravi ship tile mock. we'll reconvene Thu 10am to confirm. :thumbsup:
